text.body: kadā pakṣīndrāṃsopari gatamajaṃ kañcanayanam ramāsaṃśliṣṭāṅgaṃ gaganarucamāpītavasanam | gadāśaṅkhāmbhojārivaramālokya suciraṃ gamiṣyatyetanme nanu saphalatāṃ netrayugalam || 1|| kadā kṣīrābdhyantaḥ surataruvanāntarmaṇimaye samāsīnaṃ pīṭhe jaladhitanayāliṅgitatanum | stutaṃ devairnityaṃ munivarakadambairabhinutam stavaiḥ santoṣyāmi śrutivacanagarbhaiḥ suragurum || 2|| kadā māmābhītaṃ bhayajaladhitastāpasatanuṃ gatā rāgaṃ gaṅgātaṭagiriguhāvāsasahanam | lapantaṃ he viṣṇo suravara rameśeti satataṃ samabhyetyodāraṃ kamalanayano vakṣyati vacaḥ || 3|| kadā me hṛdpadme bhramara iva padme prativasan sadā dhyānābhyāsādaniśamupahūto vibhurasau | sphurajjyotīrūpo raviriva rasāsevyacaraṇo hariṣyatyajñānājjanitatimiraṃ tūrṇamakhilam || 4|| kadā me bhogāśā nibiḍabhavapāśāduparataṃ tapaḥśuddhaṃ buddhaṃ guruvacanatodairacapalam | mano maunaṃ kṛtvā haricaraṇayoścāru suciraṃ sthitiṃ sthāṇuprāyāṃ bhavabhayaharāṃ yāsyati parām || 5|| kadā me saṃruddhākhilakaraṇajālasya parito jitāśeṣaprāṇānilaparikarasya prajapataḥ | sadoṅkāraṃ cittaṃ haripadasaroje dhṛtavataḥ sameṣyatyullāsaṃ muhurakhilaromāvaliriyam || 6|| kadā prārabdhānte pariśithilatāṃ gacchati śanaiḥ śarīre cākṣaughe'pyuparatavati prāṇapavane | vadatyūrdhvaṃ śaśvanmama vadanakañje muhuraho kariṣyatyāvāsaṃ haririti padaṃ pāvanatamam || 7|| kadā hitvā jīrṇāṃ tvacamiva bhujaṅgastanumimāṃ caturbāhuścakrāmbujadarakaraḥ pītavasanaḥ | ghanaśyāmo dūtairgaganagatinīto natiparairgamiṣyāmīśasyāntikamakhiladuḥkhāntakamiti || 8|| || iti śrīmatparamahaṃsasvāmibrahmānandaviracitaṃ abhilāṣāṣṭakaṃ sampūrṇam ||
